title: Dual-role iron catalyst for covalent triazine framework synthesis and efficient CO2 cycloaddition under mild conditions
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00231E, Paper
Open Access

Mozhdeh Pourmansouri, Negin Amiraslani, Piero Mastrorilli, Stefano Todisco, Mojtaba Khorasani
An earth-abundant iron catalyst plays a dual role: first, constructing a porous covalent triazine framework, and then efficiently converting CO2 into cyclic carbonates under mild conditions.
